ask_collection_delete: The collection “{name}” goes. The {n} sentences in it stay — they are yours, not its.
ask_delete_this: {text} and its recording will be removed. This cannot be undone.
azure_bad_pair: Azure turned the key down. Usually it is the region: it has to be the one your Speech resource is in, not the one your account is in.
azure_body: Azure is a paid service and needs an account. Your key stays in this browser; the request goes from here straight to Microsoft, never through a server of ours.
azure_failed: The check failed — try again later.
azure_unreachable: The region does not answer — is the region name right?
azure_warn: Recordings made with a cloud voice cannot be made again if the account goes away. The bundled voices stay.
backup_hint: Restoring adds and never overwrites — a single collection’s file is read here too. A single collection is saved through the ⋯ menu beside its name.
backup_intro: The sentences live in this browser. Clearing its data takes them with it, so keep a copy — it is the only thing here that cannot be made again. The audio files can, at any time.
backup_notice: This file holds every sentence and collection, but no recordings — those are made again when you restore. An Azure key is not in it either, and must be entered again.
backup_too_new: This file comes from a newer version of mitreden.
collection_voice_cost_empty: Nothing in it yet — the first sentences will be recorded in this voice.
collection_voice_cost_one: The sentence in it will read as changed since it was recorded. The recording stays exactly as it is.
collection_voice_cost_other: The {n} sentences in it will read as changed since they were recorded. The recordings stay exactly as they are.
collection_voice_lead: “{name}” records in this voice. It applies to every sentence in it, including the ones already recorded.
danger_body: Every collection, every sentence and every recording.
db_refused_body: This library was made by an earlier version of mitreden that this version cannot read. Nothing has been changed: the sentences and the recordings are still there. Starting fresh deletes them for good.
done_import_revoiced: {n} of them had a voice this page does not have; they will be recorded in the one selected above.
done_pen_bare_one: {sentences} as an Anybook project, without a start code. Open it in Anybook Studio, transfer to the pen, then print the sheet.
done_pen_bare_other: {sentences} as an Anybook project on {n} sheets, without a start code. Open it in Anybook Studio, transfer to the pen, then print the sheets.
done_pen_one: {sentences} as an Anybook project, plus a start code. Open it in Anybook Studio, transfer to the pen, then print the sheet.
done_pen_other: {sentences} as an Anybook project on {n} sheets, plus a start code. Open it in Anybook Studio, transfer to the pen, then print the sheets.
done_restore: {collections} collections restored: {added} sentences added, {merged} already there.
empty_start: Type a sentence above and press {key}.
import_failed: That file could not be read: {error}
key_saved: {label} unlocked — {n} voices to choose from now.
language_hint: Applies to this page and is remembered here. It does not change the sentences themselves.
new_phrases_hint:
Again!
It's my turn.
Leave me alone.
nothing_to_record: Everything here is already recorded in the collection’s voice.
pen_ask_code_why: Without it the sheet can never be used on a second pen. On a part-used sheet it is usually already stuck down.
pen_ask_paper: Avery label sheets, {per} labels per sheet
pen_sheet_code: the first sticker is the start code
pen_sheet_paper: {product} · {n} labels per sheet · print at 100%, no scaling · {url}
region_hint: It is on your Speech resource in the Azure portal, e.g. westeurope.
shelf_offline: The collection could not be fetched: {error}
shelf_unknown: There is no such collection here. lautstark.tech/sammlungen has what there is.
theme_hint: With no choice of your own, mitreden follows the device — and turns with it when the device goes dark in the evening. The choice applies in this browser only.
voice_default_hint: Applies to the next new collection, and to sentences that are in none. What one collection records in is in the ⋯ menu beside its name.
voice_rushes_fragments: Speaks single words very briefly. With a punctuation mark at the end — Hello! — the voice takes its time.
danger_ask_browser: {n} sentences, every collection and every recording will be gone — in this browser. This cannot be undone.
danger_ask_folder: {n} sentences, every collection and every recording will be gone — in the folder “{folder}” too, and so on every device that uses it. This cannot be undone.
danger_blocked: The folder “{folder}” is not answering. Deleting would empty this browser only — the folder would keep everything and hand it back on the next start. Reconnect the folder and try again.
